Coffee Reader. Simple, fast, a little punk. No account. Your reading list lives on this device.

Flow mixes articles from your sources. Time depth starts at Since last visit; select 1, 3, 5, 7, 14 or 30 days for a wider view. Group by source groups publishers alphabetically. Tap an article to open it in your default browser. Read articles stay visible in gray. Tap the arrow to expand its RSS summary. Use Refresh to fetch new articles.

All sources lists your RSS channels alphabetically. Swipe right for Limits / Tags, then Save. New sources start with three visible articles. Swipe left and confirm Delete to remove a source, its downloaded articles and its bookmarks. Other sources are unaffected.

Five tags, yours to rename in Tags. Tags apply to entire RSS sources. Tap a bottom tag to filter your flow; tap it again or tap All to clear the filter. Display tags on main screen controls the bottom bar.
Saved articles are stored on this device and included in exports. By name sorts by source name; By time sorts by the time saved. Swipe left to remove a bookmark. Undo restores it.

Export feeds creates a plain-text link through dpaste.com for 24 hours, or saves a JSON file. Anyone with the link can read the export. Import feeds accepts the link, its QR code or a JSON file. Imports and ready feed sets only add missing sources and bookmarks; duplicates are skipped.

Each fetch stops at 100 entries or 6 MB of decompressed feed data, whichever comes first. Only complete entries are kept. The publisher determines their order and how much history RSS includes. Older articles may be unavailable even with a longer Time depth. Previously downloaded articles are kept for up to 30 days; bookmarks stay until removed.
The feed reached 6 MB before a complete usable article was found. Try a smaller or topic-specific RSS feed.
